programme.desc: Wondering who to root for at the 2026 Milan Cortina Olympic Winter Games? My New Favorite Olympian introduces Team USA's most inspiring athletes and the causes they champion. Hear U.S. bobsledder Kaillie Humphries open up about her IVF journey and becoming a first-time mother, hockey star Charlie McAvoy discuss his close bond with his father and how his career as a plumber helped mold Charlie into a better hockey player and father, and figure skater Amber Glenn, who shares her story about coming out and how it made her a better athlete on the ice.
